csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Beaver Municipal Airport Construct a Box Hangar. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to construct a box hangar. Airport hangar space is in great demand. This project will increase storage capacity and support airport growth through the construction of a new box hangar. This is in support of a statewide effort to increase revenue generating hangar facilities at airports across the state.
